info.title: SendClover API
info.description: API for a self-hosted SendClover installation. Mutations retry safely only with a caller-provided stable Idempotency-Key.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key reused for every retry.

logoUrl.description: Send an empty string to clear this value.

accentColor.description: Six-digit hex color, or an empty string to clear.

defaultSender.description: Send an empty string to clear this value.

replyTo.description: Send an empty string to clear this value.
